source.station_label: LIBERIA ELWA (1971 interval signal; provisional 60 m assignment)
source.date_certainty: Year only; frequency and time assumed
source.notes: PROVISIONAL reconstruction authorized by the user, not confirmed recording metadata. Dan Greenall labels this interval-signal recording 1971; no recording frequency or UTC time is stated. 4770 kHz was ELWA's documented tropical-band frequency in Dec 1973 NASWA (PDF p. 5) and Feb 1974 SPEEDX (PDF p. 28), but cannot be assigned to this clip as a confirmed fact. Approximately 0600 GMT is the user-approved provisional receiver placement, not a verified recording time. Contemporary schedules show 0600 GMT (1973) and 0555 GMT (1974, Sunday 0630); these contextual schedules do not establish this clip's time. The separately linked 1970 Arabic-ID clip was on 15095 kHz and is not the audio used here. The previously discussed 1961 recording is on 11975 kc/s, not 60 m. Existing master ID 95 already provides a documented 4770 kHz ELWA sign-on at 0601 UTC on 1980-03-29 and is unchanged.
